scripts.test: zig build test-native-host && zig build test-highlight && zig test src/native/selection.zig && zig test src/native/keyboard.zig && zig test src/native/patch.zig && zig test src/native/git.zig && zig test src/native/review.zig && zig test src/native/motion.zig && zig test src/native/lookup.zig && zig test src/native/words.zig && zig test src/native/regex.zig && pnpm test:native && pnpm test:web
scripts.typecheck: pnpm routes:generate && tsrs --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsrs --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check
scripts.package: pnpm build && native package --target macos --output zig-out/Patch.app --binary zig-out/bin/patch --signing adhoc --web-layer exclude
scripts.package:linux: pnpm build && native package --target linux --output zig-out/patch-linux --binary zig-out/bin/patch --web-layer exclude
scripts.package:windows: zig build -Dtarget=x86_64-windows-gnu && native package --target windows --output zig-out/patch-windows --binary zig-out/bin/patch.exe --web-layer exclude
scripts.test:ui: zig build -Dautomation=true && node scripts/keyboard-smoke.mjs && node scripts/mouse-smoke.mjs && node scripts/native-smoke.mjs
